basic_details.job_title: CPCL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Online for Trade, Technician & Graduate Apprentice Posts
basic_details.short_information: Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited (CPCL) is inviting online applications for Trade Apprentice (ITI Passed), Laboratory Assistant (Chemical Plant) / Guest House Service Asst., Graduate Apprentice (Non-Eng. Degree), Graduate Apprentice (Secretarial Office Assistant – Oil & Gas), Executive (Human Resource) - Oil & Gas, Graduate Apprentice (Degree in Engineering), Technician Apprentice (Diploma in Engineering), and Trade Apprentice (Data Entry Operator) posts under its 2026 recruitment notification HRD:03:26. Candidates are engaged on a contract basis under the Apprenticeship Act, 1961, with s

qualification.details: Candidates must have acquired educational qualifications as prescribed above from a recognized institution and must have registered on the respective Apprenticeship portal (NAPS, NATS) with 100% profile completion. Only those who have passed their final exams in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026 are eligible to apply. Candidates must possess a First Class in the qualifying examination with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD). Candidates awaiting results or who have undergone a job elsewhere for one year or more are not eligible.

salary_details.details: Stipends range from Rs. 4,800/- to Rs. 12,300/- per month depending on the trade or apprenticeship category. For apprentices engaged under NATS, 50% of the total stipend will be paid through Direct Beneficiary Transfer (DBT) by the Government, requiring candidates to have an active Aadhaar-seeded bank account that is DBT-enabled.

selection_process: Shortlisting of candidates will be done based on a merit list formed on the basis of the percentage of marks obtained in the essential qualification applicable to the respective trade.
how_to_apply: Visit the respective portal depending on your trade: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) website at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in for Sl. No. 1, 2, 4, 5, and 8, or National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) website at https://nats.education.gov.in/student register.php for Sl. No. 3, 6, and 7.
Register on the NATS / NAPS Apprenticeship Portal as applicable and complete your profile to 100% profile completion.
LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID or Email ID.
Search and apply for the Apprenticeship Openings / Opportunities with “Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited” as the Establishment Name.
Complete or update your profile by uploading all required documents and submit the application online through the respective apprenticeship portal.

rows.details: ITI Trades, Laboratory Assistant, Guest House Service Asst., Graduate Apprentice (Non-Eng. & Eng.), Secretarial Office Assistant, Executive (HR), Technician Apprentice, Data Entry Operator

rows.prescribed_qualification: Passed B.Sc., Chemistry with Physics, Mathematic or Biology (for Laboratory Assistant) or 10th Pass (for Guest House Service Asst.).
rows.stipend_per_month: Rs. 12300/- (Lab Assistant) / Rs. 8,200/- (Guest House Service Asst.)

rows.prescribed_qualification: BA / B. Com / BSc / BCA / BBA Degree.

rows.name_of_the_trade_post: Graduate Apprentice: Secretarial Office Assistant – Oil & Gas
Optional Trade: Executive (Human Resource) - Oil & Gas
rows.prescribed_qualification: MBA (HR) / MSW / Post Graduate Diploma in Personnel Management / Personnel Management & Industrial Relation (2 years full time Course).

Passed BE / B.Tech in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Electronic & Communication / Instrumentation, Civil, Computer Science, Information Technology, Fire & Safety and Environment Protection & Safety disciplines.
Passed Diploma in Chemical, Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Electronic & Communication / Instrumentation discipline.

rows.name_of_the_trade_post: Trade Apprentice: Data Entry Operator (Fresher Apprentice) / Data Entry Operator (Skilled Certificate Holders)
rows.prescribed_qualification: Class 12th passed but below Graduate. For Skilled Certificate Holders, additional possession of Skill Certificate of ‘Domestic Data Entry Operator’ for training of less than one year issued by an awarding body recognized under NSQF or Central Government.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates must have acquired educational qualifications as prescribed above from a recognized institution and must have registered on the respective Apprenticeship portal (NAPS, NATS) with 100% profile completion. Only those who have passed their final exams in 2022, 2023, 2024, 2025, and 2026 are eligible to apply. Candidates must possess a First Class in the qualifying examination with a minimum of 60% marks (55% for SC/ST/PwBD). Candidates awaiting results or who have undergone a job elsewhere for one year or more are not eligible. Minimum 18 years and maximum 26 years as on the date of reckoning i.e., 01.10.2026. Relaxation will be given as per Presidential Directives on Reservation.

content_sections.text: Stipends range from Rs. 4,800/- to Rs. 12,300/- per month depending on the trade or apprenticeship category. For apprentices engaged under NATS, 50% of the total stipend will be paid through Direct Beneficiary Transfer (DBT) by the Government, requiring candidates to have an active Aadhaar-seeded bank account that is DBT-enabled.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CPCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Visit the respective portal depending on your trade: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS) website at www.apprenticeshipindia.gov.in for Sl. No. 1, 2, 4, 5, and 8, or National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) website at https://nats.education.gov.in/student register.php for Sl. No. 3, 6, and 7. Register on the NATS / NAPS Apprenticeship Portal as applicable and complete your profile to 100% profile completion. LOGIN to the respective NATS/NAPS portal using your User ID or Email ID. Search and apply for the Apprenticeship Openings / Opportunities with “Chennai Petroleum Corporation Limited” as the Establishment Name. Complete or update your profile by uploading all required documents and submit the application online through the respective apprenticeship portal.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for CPCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date of submission of applications through the NATS/NAPS portal is 22.10.2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the age limit for CPCL Apprenticeship 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 26 years old as on 01.10.2026, with relaxation given as per Presidential Directives on Reservation.

faq.question: Q3. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates awaiting results, those who do not possess the required First Class marks (60% for general, 55% for SC/ST/PwBD), or those who have undergone a job elsewhere for one year or more are not eligible.

faq.question: Q4. Which portal should I use to apply for Graduate Engineering Apprentices?
faq.answer: Candidates willing to apply for Graduate Apprentices (Degree in Engineering), Technician Apprentices, and Graduate Apprentices with Non-Eng. Degrees (Sl. No. 3, 6, & 7) must apply through the National Apprenticeship Training Scheme (NATS) portal.

faq.question: Q5. What documents or bank account setups are required for NATS applicants?
faq.answer: Candidates under the NATS portal must have an active Aadhaar-seeded bank account that is DBT-enabled for Direct Benefit Transfer, and must submit these details during the application along with uploading required profile documents.
